tools.name: list_venues
tools.description:
List every venue (exchange or market) with how many books we carry, how many are live, and whether
    history is available. Use the venue ids it returns in the other tools.

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description:
List the symbols (books) on one venue with best bid/ask and status. Optional search filters by
    symbol or base asset (e.g. 'SOL'). For Kalshi/Polymarket prefer search_prediction_markets.

tools.name: get_order_book
tools.description:
Live order book for one symbol on one venue: bids and asks as [price, size], best levels, mid,
    spread (absolute and basis points), last trade, feed status and book age. symbol can be loose
    ('BTC', 'BTC-USDT', 'BTCUSDT') or an exact Kalshi/Polymarket ticker. depth is per side (max 50).

tools.name: compare_venues
tools.description:
Top of book for one asset (e.g. 'BTC', 'SOL') on every crypto exchange we carry, in one quote
    currency (USDT by default; 'USD' for Coinbase, Gemini and Bitfinex). Returns each venue's best
    bid/ask, spread in bps, deviation from the median mid, plus the consolidated best bid and offer
    (wh

tools.name: get_consolidated_book
tools.description:
Depth merged across every live crypto exchange for one asset: at each price, the total size and
    the size per venue. exclude_venues is a comma-separated list of venue ids to leave out. Venues whose
    price is far from the others (usually a stale book) are left out unless include_outliers is tru

tools.name: get_kalshi_perps
tools.description:
Kalshi perpetual futures: every contract with its live best bid/ask from our feed, contract size,
    underlying, reference and mark prices, funding cap, open interest, 24h volume and whether the market
    is open. asset_class filters (e.g. 'Crypto', 'Equity'). Stock perps follow stock-market hours

tools.name: search_prediction_markets
tools.description:
Search Kalshi event contracts and Polymarket markets by text (e.g. 'bitcoin', 'election', 'Fed').
    Returns tickers with titles, strikes/outcomes, close times and live best bid/ask (probability, 0-1).
    Use get_order_book(venue, ticker) for the full book.

tools.name: list_history
tools.description:
Dates with recorded order-book history, per venue (crypto exchanges, about the last 30 days).
    With a venue, also lists the symbols recorded on its most recent day.

tools.name: get_historical_book
tools.description:
Recorded order-book snapshots for one symbol over a time window, replayed from our raw captures.
    date is YYYY-MM-DD; start/end are HH:MM[:SS] US Eastern time; window up to 2 hours; interval_seconds
    5..600 (one snapshot per interval); levels_per_side up to 20. Use list_history for dates and s
